meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 装上后, Claude 能处理生物代谢模型: 读取或保存 SBML/JSON 等格式的模型, 运行通量平衡分析(FBA)、通量变异分析(FVA)、基因敲除模拟、通量采样等, 也能构建新模型或给模型补洞。
howto.when: 当你想加载或构建代谢模型、做基因敲除模拟、计算代谢通量(FBA)等任务时, 这个技能会接管。

say.text: 加载教科书模型, 预测它的最大生长速率。
say.note: 会运行 FBA 并输出生长速率。

say.text: 把基因 b0008 敲除, 再看生长速率的变化。
say.note: 会进行单基因敲除模拟, 与野生型对比。

say.text: 帮我算一个无氧条件下的最小培养基成分。
say.note: 会调用 minimal_medium 来求解。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can handle metabolic models: load/save SBML/JSON/YAML, run FBA, FVA, gene knockout simulations, flux sampling, and build or gap-fill models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to load or build metabolic models, simulate gene knockouts, compute metabolic fluxes (e.g., FBA), or similar tasks.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model and compute its maximum growth rate.
say_en.note: Runs FBA and reports the growth rate.

say_en.text: Knock out gene b0008 and see how the growth rate changes.
Find a minimal medium for anaerobic growth on this model.
